purpose: Five-panel home background: three upper actions, two lower installed-content lists.

prompts.initial:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production game-editor homepage background, wide 16:9 landscape, target 1920x1080.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and strict style reference: existing medieval harbor dashboard with three upper panels and one lower panel.
Primary request: change ONLY the lower panel layout so the home screen accommodates the new Civilization Edits panel next to Custom Maps. There must be FIVE empty frames total: the original THREE tall upper tool frames remain unchanged, and TWO equally sized wide lower frames sit side by side. This is a careful same-style revision, not a new art direction.
Invariants: preserve the entire upper half, the three top frames, the top shield and navy drapery, their exact current positions/proportions, the dark weathered stone and beveled antique gold/brass materials, the richness of the navy heraldic banners, the realistic painterly medieval strategy-game illustration style, stormy harbor and firelight. Maintain the reference's precise palette, lighting and texture. Do not vary the style.
Lower layout: remove the single centered lower panel and replace it with TWO matching wide blank stone frames. Left outer frame spans x10.5%-49.2% of canvas. Right outer frame spans x50.8%-89.5%. Both outer frames run y52%-91%. Mirror their sizes, corner ornaments, bevel thickness and shadow, with a visible thin harbor-water gap between them. Interiors must be quietly dark empty stone, able to hold lists and headings rendered by the app. App content rectangles are left x11.2%-48.7% and right x51.3%-88.8%, both y53%-88.3%; put ornate edges around this content, with title text/list safe inset. Keep lower plate interiors undivided and text-free because the application draws its own recessed list wells. Retain small original shield flourish centered below each lower frame, fully within bottom y91%-95%. Clearly separate both lower frames from the top row.
Surroundings: keep the left statue, anchor, right barrel, lion shield, fires, tower walls, sea, and cobblestones visible where the widened lower panels allow; tuck the anchor/barrel/shield closer to the side margins if needed so they do not intrude into panel interiors. Match their original rendering exactly. Do not add new scenery or symbols.
Constraints: five panels only, no labels, no lettering, no icons inside panels, no buttons, no watermark, no modern flat/vector elements, no new colors, no bright glow. All borders visible. Clean symmetrical functional composition in the exact established medieval styling.

exportMethod: Display-size derivatives resized from generated master using System.Drawing HighQualityBicubic.
invariant: Existing medieval harbor/stone/antique gold/navy styling preserved.
selection: User selected the initial compact lower frames to keep more harbor scenery visible.
